newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 6.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 6.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones fell by 49.94 points to 5,606.96. PLDT's ADR was up by $ 7/8 to $61.
* The peso closed at 26.22 to a U.S.dollar from 26.228.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,191.56, down 6.04.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate dropped to 12.59375 percent from 12.78125.
